name: @w6w-apps/deel
description: Manage Deel contracts, people, time off, timesheets and invoice adjustments.

w6w.longDescription:
Deel manages contracts, people, time off, timesheets and invoice adjustments for a global workforce, exposing what an HR or finance workflow needs without going near payroll or employment-record changes. Contracts can be listed, read and terminated; workers' profiles, personal details and department assignments can be read and updated; time off can be requested, approved or cancelled against a worker's actual leave balance; and timesheets and invoice adjustments — bonuses, expenses, deductions — can be logged against a contract.

Money-moving actions are marked as non-idempotent on purpose, since retrying a milestone, adjustment or timesheet submission pays twice rather than correcting a mistake. Time-off requests can either enter Deel's own approval chain or be created directly in a given status, for a workflow that has already collected approval elsewhere.

Webhooks can be registered and listed so a workflow can react to Deel's own events rather than polling. Employment-record administration — EOR and global payroll worker data, the applicant tracking system, immigration and compliance screening — is deliberately out of scope; those are separate products with their own legal weight and belong to their own integrations.
